description: Evans DPC belt risk ratio under two-sided misreporting: a fraction f of belted-coded survivors truly unbelted (existing scenario) crossed with a fraction g of unbelted-coded deaths truly belted (reverse error); tipping_f_given_g / tipping_g_given_f are the error rates at which the RR reaches 1 with the other rate fixed
population: FARS 2016-2024 occupants (driver/passenger) of in-transport light passenger vehicles, seat front-left/front-other/second row, age 13+, belted or unbelted, known outcome; vehicles with one eligible driver and one right-front passenger
method: Closed-form expected-cell reclassification (survivors keep, deaths keep their other status), percentile bootstrap CIs over crashes (2000 replicates); g = 0 rows reproduce the one-sided scenarios in double_pair_comparison
